subject: [PATCH] mm: zswap: don't fail a large-folio swapin whose range is not in zswap

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the zswap compression algorithm where it incorrectly rejects large folios when zswap is enabled after they have been allocated. The problem occurs because zswap checks if it's enabled before reading from the swap device, but this check can be delayed by the allocation and pinning of high-order folios. To fix this, the patch adds a function to scan the range of slots instead of rejecting the folio outright. If none of the slots in the range are compressed by zswap, it returns -ENOENT and allows the swap device to read the data. Otherwise, it still refuses to serve large folios that cannot be reconstructed by zswap.
